title: "Make Mouse gene_id mapping table"

```{r, setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '.')
```


```{r}
library(biomaRt)
```



# From Ensembl

## Retreive GeneID mapping table from Ensembl using biomaRt package
```{r}
mart <- biomaRt::useEnsembl('genes','hsapiens_gene_ensembl')
geneid_map <- biomaRt::getBM(
  mart = mart,
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","entrezgene_id","hgnc_id","external_gene_name","gene_biotype")
)
write.table(geneid_map,file="geneid_map.tsv",sep="\t",row.names = FALSE)
```


## GO terms
```{r}
local({
  x <- getBM(
    mart = mart,
    attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","go_id")
  )
  write.table(x,file="ensembl_go_id.tsv",sep="\t",row.names = FALSE)
})
```

```{r}
local({
  x <- getBM(
    mart = mart,
    attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","goslim_goa_accession")
  )
  write.table(x,file="ensembl_goslim_goa.tsv",sep="\t",row.names = FALSE)
})
```

```{r}
download.file("http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/go/go-basic.obo","go-basic.obo")
```

# Reactome pathways
```{r}
download.file("https://reactome.org/download/current/Ensembl2Reactome.txt","Ensembl2Reactome.txt")
```

# MsigDB (GSEA)

warning: this chunk require user authentication to run => download the zip manually from the website.

```{r,eval=FALSE}
download.file(

  "msigdb_v2022.1.Hs_files_to_download_locally.zip"
)
```
